newsitem.title: ISRAEL: BASKETBALL-MACCABI TEL AVIV BEAT TURKS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-MACCABI TEL AVIV BEAT TURKS.

text.p: Israeli champions Maccabi Tel Aviv advanced to the upper group in stage two of the EuroLeague after a tight 71-65 win over Ulker Spor of Turkey on Thursday.

It was left to the last round in stage one of Europe's premier basketball competition before the final line-up in group A was determined, with the winners of the Maccabi-Ulker match clinching third place and gaining a berth in the stronger stage two group.

The Israeli team had Romanian Constantin Popa to thank for their win. The 2.2 metre (7 ft 2.6 in) centre controlled the defence and forced errors from the dangerous Turks, who possessed excellent outside shooters.
Popa finished with 18 points and eight crucial rebounds.
Maccabi swept into the lead for the first time in the game just five minutes from the end. The home team were 32-36 down at halftime.
Popa was supported by some good outside shooting from Brad Leaf and Buck Johnson, who both scored 14 points.

Orhun Ene was the dominant Ulker marksman with 21 points but the Turks, who are experts at the three-point shot, also saw Haluk Yirdilim and Dan Godfread strike from long range. Godfread finished with 14 points.
